post.title: An alarm clock on a subscription. Alarmist is free.
post.caption: Two fresh grudges: an alarm clock you rent by the month, and Mac macro software that wants paying for pressing keys.

segments.gripe: An alarm clock, on a subscription.
segments.quote: mostly so I wouldn't have to pay a subscription for an alarm clock.

cues.cap: So: Alarmist. Scan the toothpaste to stop it.
